text.p: These are the leading stories in the Namibian press on Thursday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- U.S. vice president Al Gore is expected to make a brief stopover in Namibia next week on his way to South Africa.

- The Namibian government has provided some relief for fish companies by reducing the quota fee on mid-water trawler horse mackeral to zero. Cabinet also approved the waiving of fees on uncaught quotas if more than 20 percent of the total allowable catch is not landed.
- Five companies have been awarded rights to exploit deep water fishing on Namibia's coast.
- The Southern African Development Community (SADC) is putting emphasis on the tourism sector to help develop remote areas and distribute wealth to local communities.
